newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin closes up four cents on increased buying.
newsitem.headline: KL tin closes up four cents on increased buying.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price closed up four cents at 15.02 ringgit ($6.03) a kg on increased buying despite absence of lead from the London Metal Exchange (LME) which was closed for a holiday on Monday, traders said.
"There were bids for 158 tonnes at the opening against offers for 119 tonnes. But some of the buyers withdrew as the price increased," said one trader.
Final turnover was 125 tonnes against 121 on Monday, and buyers were from Europe, Japan and Malaysia.
The local premium over LME widened to $40 a tonne against $20 previously.--Syed Azman (603-230-8911) ($1=2.4920 ringgit)
